With G(x)=x*A(x)=sum_l G_l*x^l, G0=R, coefficients obey n*c[k,n]=sum_(l=0..n) G_l*c[k-1,n-l], solved in increasing epsilon power at each n. Initial c[k,0] come from the source; c[0,n>0]=0.
